The '''government''' headed by [[Belo Tusus]] overthrew the [[Ortolan government]] in the late stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and seized power of [[Orto/Legends|Orto]]. The government was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and suffered continual sabotage and undermining from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nem Bees]].
